name: Real Rent Growth

sources.2014: ACS 5-Year 2010-2014, table B25064 (median gross rent), Census Summary File Seq105
sources.2019: ACS 5-Year 2015-2019, table B25064, Census Summary File Seq114
sources.2023: ACS 5-Year 2019-2023, table B25064, Census Table-Based Summary File
sources.cpi: BLS CPI-U (CPIAUCSL) via FRED, annual averages at window midpoints

note: Median gross rent is an ACS 5-year estimate for the whole window; growth is the ratio of vintage medians (different renter populations), not a repeat-rent index. Counties with no cash-rent households or suppressed values are omitted.
